title: The Theory of Strategic Evolution: Three Principles of Strategic Replicators
abstract: arXiv:2512.07901v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Strategic replicators combine evaluated choice and reproductive transmission. An agent chooses among alternatives; the consequences of those choices influence continuation or reproduction; and successors receive organization that shapes later choices. Artificial intelligence makes this combination salient when agents have authority to create, configure, or retire software instances. This paper organizes the general logic around three principles: situated choice, reproductive transmission, and institution-mediated coupling. The principles are constitutive rather than predictions of growth or improvement. A common representation distinguishes carriers, inherited records, decision owners, and the mechanisms that allocate consequences. Actual parent-descendant attribution yields a selection-transmission identity. Separate compatibility results characterize when utility-maximizing choices also maximize a reproductive criterion. Gode

translated_title: 战略演化理论：战略复制子的三大原则
translated_abstract: 战略复制子将经过评估的选择与繁殖式传递相结合。智能体在多个备选项中进行选择；这些选择的后果会影响其延续或繁殖；而后继者所获得的组织形式又会塑造其后续的选择。当智能体拥有创建、配置或退役软件实例的权限时，人工智能使这种结合变得尤为突出。本文围绕三大原则来组织这一般逻辑：情境化选择、繁殖式传递以及制度中介耦合。这些原则是构成性的，而非对增长或改进的预测。一个统一的表示方法区分了载体、继承记录、决策所有者以及分配后果的机制。实际的亲代-子代归因产生了一个选择-传递恒等式。若干独立的相容性结果刻画了何时效用最大化的选择同时也最大化某个繁殖准则。Gode……
tldr: 本文提出“战略演化理论”，以情境化选择、繁殖式传递和制度中介耦合三大构成性原则刻画“战略复制子”的一般逻辑，为人工智能时代智能体创建、配置与退役软件实例的演化过程提供了统一表示框架和选择-传递恒等式。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a theory of strategic evolution based on three constitutive principles—situated choice, reproductive transmission, and institution-mediated coupling—offering a unified representation and a selection-transmission identity for how agents evolve when AI enables them to create, configure, or retire software instances.
